svg.title: Diagram: two gates and the transaction spine for agent purchases
svg.desc: A hand-drawn notebook diagram. Two boxes on the left, You say yes and Store says yes, both point to Agent tries to buy, which points to Checkout plus payment, which points down to If it breaks. The flow shows user authorization and retailer acceptance as separate gates, with liability falling back on the shopper and deployer. Animated version draws in article order with ink dots traveling each arrow.

text.tspan: Retailer terms dated Oct-Nov 2026; recheck - pages drift.
Dispute regime is forecast only; Gateway terms-described, not tested.
